items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1972-04-05
items.q: He'd want a band, he'd pick us up and, come on, let's go.

ctx.x: He'd want a band, he'd pick us up and, come on, let's go. And you did? We'd go in by a little white. Y'all want to go by? Yeah, yeah, sure. He'd know, we'd know what we was going to make, you see. And, uh, this fellow King, he was a big multi-milli- he was a big millionaire. Uh-huh. Uh, we wouldn't lose nothing. We'd make good money and drink us up in the house, you know, drink champagne with them women and all of them, having a good time. Mm-hmm. Until we get, until he get tired out and pay us off, you see.
Well, would George Jones get high? Would he climb up, uh, the high?
